open_points.text: _stop_start: [BEHAVIOR] MUST write diagnostic unchanged, followed by one line end, on the process's standard error, nothing else and no value added to it, a diagnostic being one line naming no value as every step that answers one makes it, and MUST answer a non-zero exit status for the process.
open_points.question: Which must change: must the contract guarantee that diagnostic is one line and names no value, or must the note define behavior for every str, since preserving an arbitrary multiline or value-bearing str unchanged cannot also make it one line naming no value?
